assessments.reasoning: The release 7.54 abstract-entity entry identifies the element list as the basis of the structured type. Its ABAP-program passage expressly permits that type after TYPE. The database-object passage establishes the applicability boundary, and the ABAP-program passage separately excludes the entity as an ABAP SQL SELECT source.

challenge.method: Check whether the lack of a database object prevents ABAP type use, or whether type use implies SQL read access.
challenge.results: SAP addresses both operations for the same abstract entity. It permits the type reference and expressly excludes the SQL source use.

limitations: An abstract CDS entity has no database object. SAP expressly excludes its use as a data source for ABAP SQL SELECT.
The page documents an abstract CDS entity in SAP AS ABAP 7.54. The entity has no database object and ABAP SQL SELECT cannot use it as a data source.
